summary.text: Jeff Waldstreicher is a Democratic member of the Maryland State Senate from District 18 who has served since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he served in the House of Delegates from 2007 to 2019 and is vice chair of the Judicial Proceedings Committee.

paragraphs.text: Waldstreicher was born in Silver Spring, Maryland, on December 31, 1979, graduated from Montgomery Blair High School, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science and history from Emory University and a law degree from the University of California, Berkeley, in 2003, where he was an editor of the California Law Review.
Ballotpedia says he lives in Kensington, Maryland, and lists work as pro bono counsel with the Sierra Club.

Waldstreicher served in the House of Delegates from 2007 to 2019, on the Judiciary Committee from 2007 to 2015, where he chaired the Estates and Trusts Subcommittee, and on the Economic Matters Committee from 2015 to 2018.
He was first elected to the Senate in 2018 and has served since January 9, 2019.
He has been vice chair of the Judicial Proceedings Committee since 2020 and is Senate chair of the Joint Committee on Federal Relations.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.
